review_text: The staff are  friendly, helpful and kind to our pets. Dr. Dadwal is the best vet we had and he has been taking care of all our pets more than 20 years now. He is very knowledgeable, detail oriented, gives his honest opinion about our pets condition, friendly and kind. We cannot thank him enough for all he does for the family. Thank you Dr. Dadwal❣️

My 6.5 year old Yorkie caught a cough so I took her to Curtner Pet Clinic and Hospital on a Saturday. The vet technician and receptionist gave me some tips to help with her symptoms until her appointment and made a same day appointment at the hospital. Dr Dadwal diagnose and the team took care of Truffle. I was not aware of kennel cough annual boosters and Dr Dadwal educated me on the different flus and possibility of kennel cough going around. She is on antibiotics and is already better after seeing the team. Will be scheduling her booster follow up with Curtner Pet Clinic once she’s done with her meds. I’ve been to other pet hospitals where they would tell me it’s nothing but the problem would persist or translate into a bigger issue. I’m very satisfied we received qualitative care.  We paid $120 for our visit which included exam and two types of meds which I believe is reasonable since it was her firs time at the hospital.

I brought my fully indoor cat here due to significant itching and scabbing under her chin and neck. At the initial visit with Dr. Bhinder, I specifically raised concern about possible flea exposure, as someone in our household regularly has contact with a dog that goes outdoors.

Despite this, no flea exam or flea preventative was discussed or provided. The exam was limited, and the diagnosis focused on a suspected allergic reaction with secondary infection.

Because my cat is anxious with vets, I had to schedule a second appointment and give her Gabapentin (sedative) before the appointment. The planned treatment was to clip and clean the scabs and administer antibiotics (Depo Medrol and Solovecin). At that appointment, the clinic had overbooked and there were no rooms or vet techs available to treat my cat. After being there for 1.5 hours, a vet assistant informed me they could not locate any scabs, the sedative wore off by the time they gave the antibiotics, and they failed to put a cone on her. After they returned my cat, I still felt the scabs under her chin and neck. I was sent home with just antiseptic wipes.

Over the next few days, her scabs worsened. I later found flea dirt on her underside, confirming flea exposure and explaining her symptoms. Fleas were never identified, ruled out, or treated during either visit, despite being raised as a concern from the beginning.

Watching my cat continue to suffer while the underlying cause of her condition went unaddressed was incredibly upsetting. I understand that anxious cats can make exams challenging, but I was disappointed that a common and treatable cause of itching was not addressed, especially given the cost and multiple visits. Based on my experience, I would encourage pet owners to seek a second opinion if their concerns persist.

The most wonderful people in the world. I have found Dr E and I will never go anywhere else. He and his staff are professional, kind, patient and compassionate. They have been there for me and my cat and dogs and went out of their way to be as thorough and accommodating as possible. I will always come here. I've had numerous vets over the years and these guys are the best.

It was my first time visiting this veterinary pet clinic.
All in all, I was very satisfied with the service provided.
I was able to express my concerns with my Kitty’s health with the doctor given that it was her first initial visit. I was educated on all the questions I had regarding any care or future flea medicine and when to estimate to schedule her spaying.

Our pets have been patients for a number of years. We love the attention they receive.  I have to give a shout out to Ali. He is so sweet and gentle with the pets and very knowledgeable. I appreciate that they don't push unnecessary products or treatments on you. Thank you to all the wonderful staff.

Ali was great. He explained the treatment plan/options to me in detail to help me determine the best route for treating my dog. He was very friendly and made me feel comfortable asking questions. Most importantly, he made my dog feel comfortable. I have tried multiple hospitals in San Jose for routine to emergency visits and I always find myself coming back here.

Amazing and respectful service for myself and my Fur-babies!!

We have been coming to this establishment for over 7 years now and have has nothing but the upmost rewarding results from this staff!! Keep up the good work team Alum rock animal hospital!!

Very disappointed, I went for a international health certificate and they gave me a paper without the certificate number required for the USDA, my poor pets after a flight of more than 17 hours waiting to be released had to get onto quarantine (which I had to pay more) just because the veterinary couldn’t give me a proper documentation with the certificate number giving by a certificate veterinarian. The answer? Tell the authorities of your country to give me a call…. So unprofessional 400 dollars per pet (x2) throw to the garbage. Lady as the desk was so rude. I normally don’t write bad reviews but this time I hope karma pays back or they get in order or just don’t issue documents you can’t support.

I helped my neighbors out by taking their pregnant dog there because she wasn't feeling so well.

I waited outside until they had a room ready (this was their Covid protocol.) When they were ready they called me and we went in.

I found the staff to be very warm and endearing. They took my doggie friend to the back, did an exam, and an xray.

I waited in the dog waiting room. She returned with my doggie friend and the verdict. She was expecting 5 pups and her symptoms were consistent with pregnancy.

The fee was pretty much what I thought it would be. We were on our way within 45 minutes.

I recommend this place for your animals needs.

I had a wonderful experience at this veterinary clinic. The doctor and staff were all so kind, caring, and professional. They took great care of my pet and made sure I understood everything that was going on. The doctor was very informative and patient, answering all of my questions. You can really tell they care about both the animals and their owners. Highly recommend!

I am beyond impressed with the care and service provided by AVMC. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel welcome and at ease. The veterinarians, veterinary technicians and the whole team are incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and thorough in their examinations. They take the time to explain every detail and answer all of our questions, ensuring we understand the best course of action for our pet's health. The clinic is clean, well-organized, and equipped with the latest technology, which further instills confidence in their capabilities. Our dog receives the highest level of care here, and we always leave feeling reassured and grateful. AVMC truly sets the standard for veterinary excellence. I highly recommend
them to anyone seeking exceptional veterinary care for their furry family members.

Took our dog to get spayed, and when we picked her up she was covered in her own throw up and poop. It was fully dried/caked on, and had obviously been sitting there for awhile. When we asked what's going on the vet told us "oh that must've just happened, we've been checking on her frequently!" Either she blatantly lied about checking on our dog, or they blatantly didn't care she was covered in her own filth when they *did* check on her. Not sure which is worse, but either way I left feeling angry and like we were just another dollar sign for them, they didn't actually care. Would not and have not gone back since, extremely unprofessional

We are so grateful for Advanced Veterinary Medical Center. They've been the most understanding vet I've come across. I don't think I'll ever trust anyone as much as I trust these guys! The TEAM is AAAAAAMMMMAAAZZINNNG. They were willing to work with several donation organizations (found on my own) to help pay for our dog's treatments. We got so many estimates and no one could beat AVMC prices. And that is not the best part, the TEAM is just incredible, I would call for any concern prior to the surgery and they were able to advise me on our concerns. I recommend this team 1000000% they truly care for your pets needs. Rocco and our family appreciate everything AVMC has done for our family.
Had a wonderful experience with the team over the years for my dog. They were extremely helpful with our relocation needs as well. Super grateful to the team and I’ll miss having them as our vet.

A satisfaction rating of 3.7 raises concerns, and unfortunately my personal experience aligns with this.
An appointment costs $120 and is charged in advance to a credit card. Without an appointment, the fee increases to $200, a difference that was not reasonably explained.

During my visit, the veterinarian declined to treat my dog, stating that my behavior was inappropriate. For clarity, my questions were solely related to a treatment package I had already purchased, for which I paid over $900. These questions were reasonable, factual, and asked in a respectful manner.

To avoid any misunderstanding, I clearly stated my willingness to proceed with treatment and to pay an additional substantial amount if required. Despite this, treatment was not initiated.

In my view, refusing to provide care to an animal under these circumstances particularly when questions relate to billing or package terms is concerning and falls short of the professional standard one would expect from a veterinary clinic.

I would not recommend this practice

We love South Bay Animal Hospital. Last year, we waited 4 hours at another ER to be seen, our female 2 year old Malinois had been attacked and had a 2.5” hole in her stomach. She was in so much pain so we left that ER and took her to South Bay Animal Hospital. We were seen immediately. she had to be sedated and stitched. This time, my other dog, a 1.5 year old male Malinois had complications to his gastroplexy, he popped a stitch. Again, We were seen immediately and they were able to sedate and re-stitch him up. My male malinois never lets anyone, vet or strangers, touch or pet him. He generally needs to be muzzled and sedated for vet visits. This visit, we didn’t have time to sedate him, only muzzle him, and surprisingly, Dr. Atwal was able to pet him! He’s the first vet that he allowed to pet him. You gotta think that they’re doing something right if my dog lets them pet him! Anyway, I always feel very comfortable going there for emergencies. I would probably go to them for regular vet visits if I didn’t live so far away. The entire team is wonderful and sensitive to dogs who have a lot of fear. But I’m of the mind that the safety of the vet, vet techs and staff, is paramount so I always muzzle and if I have time, sedate, my male malinois. So far, each time I’ve been here, I’ve been very happy with how my dogs are handled and cared for.  I always feel very confident in both the expertise of the entire team and their compassion.

Shamefully Greedy and Untrustworthy

I’m absolutely appalled by the greed and unethical practices of this pet hospital. When my cat was diagnosed with FIP, they charge us an outrageous $840 for medication that costs less than $290 when purchasing directly from the stokes pharmacy. When I questioned the price, they blatantly lied and claimed the cost would be the same if I went directly to the pharmacy. This is a COMPLETE LIE—the real price is much lower.

It’s clear that this hospital doesn’t care about your pet’s well-being—they only care about squeezing as much money out of you as possible during an emotional and stressful time. Instead of providing compassionate care, they’re focused on lining their pockets. If you value your pet and your finances, stay far away from these people. All they want is your money, not what’s best for your pet.

Disgusting and disgraceful.

I am finally writing this review, six years after boarding our dog here, to report on his continued trauma from that terrible experience.

We boarded our dog at South Bay for a full week in October 2019 during a family emergency. When we arrived for after-hours pickup on 10/14/19, the staffer on duty couldn’t locate him. After several minutes we were allowed to look ourselves. We walked past rows of crates to a set of small rooms labeled “luxury suites.” A blanket covered one door. I pulled it down and found our dog Jax in the small white room with the lights off, feces and urine everywhere, slouched in the corner, shaking, with a very fearful posture. When I asked what happened, the staff member said Jax “wouldn’t come out of the room" for his outdoor time.

Since this boarding experience, Jax has needed a muzzle and physical restraint for routine vet work—an abrupt change that began after this stay. Having worked in a dog boarding facility myself, often with over a hundred dogs at a time, the notion of leaving a dog in a room because he "wouldn't come out" is completely unacceptable. There is no conceivable scenario where that can occur, at least not for a trained pet care provider..

I regret not taking photos and escalating this experience to South Bay management way back in 2019. In that moment, my only priority was getting Jax home safely. I’m sharing our experience now so other pet owners can make informed decisions about where, and where not, to trust their pets for overnight boarding. Needless to say, we do not recommend boarding your pet at this facility.

If you don't do business with them, they report you.

I had a terrible experience with South Bay Emergency.

My dog was hit by a car and injured his back leg. I brought him to South Bay, where they quoted me $6,000 just for exams — including $500 just to shave the fur on his leg. They made it clear there was no room for negotiation and told me this was only the beginning; the actual surgery would cost even more.

I left and got second opinions from two other vets. Both gave significantly lower quotes and believed the injury was not a fracture. The X-rays showed the bone was fine, and my dog recovered fully in just a few days with basic medication — no surgery needed.

After my visit, South Bay called me multiple times asking for the names of the other clinics I went to. I chose not to share that information. Then, within a week, I received a call from the Silicon Valley Animal Control Authority saying South Bay had filed a complaint against me. Thankfully, the new vet’s records made it easy to get the complaint dismissed.

If you don't do business with them, they report you.

So now, I'm using my right to report their behavior to the public.

I had to go to this veterinary clinic as an emergency last Friday, and I was deeply impressed. I was seen very quickly, and my dog was taken care of immediately. She was even operated on the very same day, which greatly contributed to her recovery.
The team is incredibly warm and compassionate. The veterinarian who attended to us was not only extremely professional but also deeply attentive: she sat down on the floor to examine my dog, with a gentleness and closeness that truly moved me.
Everything was done the same day, efficiently and with impeccable professionalism.
Moreover, although the cost was significant, it was very reasonable considering the level of care provided: I actually paid less for the entire treatment than for a simple dental cleaning at my regular veterinarian.
I highly recommend this clinic

MedVet is so professional and kind. I brought my very scared dog in and they took their time to make him feel safe. They also gave great recommendations for a specialist’s to help my dog in the long term. Thank you!

I brought my cat to MedVet for immediate care to treat vomiting and dehydration. The staff was gentle and caring, and he received attention, diagnostic testing, and treatment very quickly. He was discharged a few hours later and had done well since then.
I appreciate the care he received.

My sweet girl Lexi needed to see a neurologist for her neck . So we came to med vet, Silicon Valley
Everyone from the front desk greeting us to the vet techs doing the triage to the doctor talking to me about the procedure. Everybody was wonderful. I felt so comfortable and that my little girl would be loved and cared for . They kept me updated with all her care before surgery and after .  I highly recommend this place 🤗
My first visit with MedVet was pleasant.  Everyone was nice and helpful.  Dr Aaron Rozental was very nice and answered my concerns about my dog.  Shiloh my doggy wants to thank you all at MedVet.

Dr. Ming and the Staff were exceptional. Even through my circumstances are unique and my dog can be a handful at the vet, they really showed me today why they are best Vet in the bay area. I was recommended many times over by different individuals and now I can recommend them as well after my first visit today. Dr Ming went above and beyond for me during the visit. He showed up, really cared,  and gave me really good advice. I attempted to see a vet prior at another office and the Dr didnt even come into the room and give my dog a chance. Thank you all very much we will be back next time.
amazing service. iana was really nice and kind. she totally explained everything to me. definitely will be back with my little dude

My dog Cinnamon has been coming here for 2 years and she has always received the best care. Over that time, she’s been seen by multiple doctors for different occasions, and every single one has treated her with kindness, patience, and professionalism. They take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure we feel comfortable with her care.

The staff is always welcoming and attentive, and it’s clear they truly care about the animals and their families. I’m so grateful to have found a place I can trust with Cinnamon’s health. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who goes above and beyond!

Was recommended this place by a close friend. I was very pleasantly surprised. They have been so friendly and so supportive of the care of our fur babies.

I’ve never felt super attached to a vet but will be doing what I can to keep this one.

My cat Orbi recently got surgery here and they were so so kind to take me in last minute, help me call the dancing cat for help with funds and do the surgery for my cat. They truly care about their clients and provide so much helpful information that I as a first time cat owner REALLY appreciate and I feel better prepared for situations like this in the future. I feel like I found a vet that truly cares and they gained a loyal customer

I’ve been bringing my golden retriever puppy to Willow Glen Pet Hospital since he was just 8 weeks old, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he’s received. From his routine check-ups and vaccines to an unexpected surgery for an intestinal blockage (thanks to something he ate!), the team has been nothing short of amazing.

They handled his surgery with incredible professionalism and compassion, and I always felt confident he was in the best hands. His recovery was smooth and quick, thanks to the thorough post-surgery care, medications, and follow-up guidance they provided.

The doctors and staff here genuinely care about their patients, and it shows in the way they treat both pets and their owners. I’m so grateful to have Willow Glen Pet Hospital looking after my pup — they’ve earned my full trust and highest recommendation.

The people here are truly amazing. They are kind, friendly, and great at what they do. The accommodations they make for my dog Sirius when needed really make a difference, like squeezing him in when injured recently despite being slammed with appointments. Dr. Williford is amazing with animals (and owners), as are every other member of the team. My dog is my closest family member, and I completely trust them with his health. Take your pets here!

Great vet and vet techs.  They handle working line breeds with skill.  Very competent and knowledgable.  All of the staff I've ever dealt with have always been friendly and professional.  Highly recommend this vet!

My pup was somehow cut pretty badly on his ear. It was on a Saturday so I had little options for vets. WGPH was accommodating and willing/able to see him. He healed up and we went back to have staples removed which was quick and easy. Friendly staff also

This was the first time here. The staff is very nice and knowledgeable. The vet technician and veterinarian were very knowledgeable. They showed great concern for Buster's health and well being. I will continue to take Buster to Willow Glen Pet Hospital.

Fast response times and genuinely friendly, helpful staff. Christina and Xochitl assisted me recently and took the time to explain every invoice item in great detail, making sure I fully understood everything before I left.

Dr. Grewal, who has been examining my cats, is incredibly kind and thorough. He clearly explained all available options and helped me choose the best path for my cats’ recovery. Everyone at AMC made sure I never felt confused or rushed.

As others have mentioned, the care here is also very affordable—excellent staff providing high-quality care. I truly appreciate this team and highly recommend AMC.

I highly recommend this place !! We have taken my dog to 4 different vets and never seen any improvement in her condition. Our dog was suffering from itching, bleeding, flaking, non stop for a few months. That was until I found this place online and hoped for the best. Thank god I took her there. The doctor here does an amazing job !! He explained everything that was going on with our pet and gave us a very detailed plan to help her problem. Our dog needed some shots and other products for her condition. The next day we saw improvement in her itching. It has been a proximately 1 month since we took her here and she is a complete different animal. She naps more comfortably, eats better, she’s happier, no longer itches all day long, her hair has grown back. We are truly grateful and satisfied with this place. Overall great staff, amazing customer service, will definitely help with any pets needs, and is completely affordable.

My brother brought his dog in here yesterday. She had a banged up arm from getting attacked by a cat. She had an X-ray to rule any broken bones, she needed antibiotics and some pain meds for her wound. Dr Grewal wanted to do a culture to identify the exact bacteria. My brother asked if doing so would be best rather than wait 10 days for the antibiotic cycle to finish, Dr Grewal  said yes. So we went with that. His dog has been home and this morning she woke up smiling and jumping on my brother. The bed side manner of the staff exceeds other vet offices in the area by far. From the front desk to the vet techs. Both gentlemen we’re very accommodating and helped. Give my brother peace of mind because they were very thoughtful and caring when handling his dog. I would recommend bringing your loved furry pets here. There is no hidden cost. They tell you what and why services are. Compared to other veterinarian offices this one by four has the best prices as well as two excellent veterinarians

I had an amazing experience at Animal Medical Center when my dog Bruno got a foxtail stuck in his airway. The staff acted quickly and with so much care, keeping me calm while making sure Bruno was safe and comfortable. The veterinarians were professional, compassionate, and explained everything clearly. their quick action and care towards Bruno means a lot to me, I’m so grateful for their kindness and expertise. I highly recommend Animal Medical Center to anyone who loves their pets healthy and happy!

I took my little pup Loki to see Dr. Grewal and the experience was amazing. Loki wasn't acting like herself and wouldn't go up and down the stairs which is very unlike her. I explained the concerns we had with her and Dr. Grewal immediately told us we need x-rays and blood work done. Once the results came back he explained what was going and what to do next. I have never been to a clinic with such fast service and care for animals. Will definitely be coming back here and no where else! Thank you Dr. Grewal!

Very nice place to recommend. I scheduled appointment for vaccination and examination for my cat. Their stuffs were super friendly and kind. Clinic space is very clean and comfort. They allowed us to get into the treatment room with my cat, which my previous clinic doesn't allow during the vaccination. I love that part. Dr. Stone is very professional and kind. The assistant gave us cat treats and catnip during the examination. I bet my cat had a super happy time during this vet visit. Recommend and will come back if any problem happen.

Dr. Carlene Kempa, DVM,  is my service toy poodle, Inky's, veterinarian.  She is very, very gentle and sweet with my baby, as is the entire staff here at SJ Animal Hospital.

I had to have my Inky get her FAVN test (good for 3 yrs and takes up to 2 months to receive results back for) and health certificates as well as tick treatments for our trips to Hawaii and she did so well, as little as she is.

There are separate non-domestic certifications for International travel and country specific import health check requirements and documentation for travelling abroad.  DOT Forms must be presented separately at every airport check-in for every single flight, even connecting flights.

**A beautiful thing; the clinic allows people to post missing pet flyers on their wall, which is just great of them to do, though sad to look over.  If you find any wandering pets please either call or bring them into your local animal shelter for them to be reunited with their families.

Definitely would recommend this clinic to any pet parent.

I have the best experience coming to this vet office. Dr. Stone been there through 2 of my animals. Dr. Stone and his assistant Carolina are amazing and attentive. They are very patient and gentle with my senior dog Jabba. Dr. Stone always opens the space to discuss any concerns or even just swap a few great stories. We never feel rushed out of the office. Coming to our vet visit feels more like an experience rather than an obligation. I will absolutely be coming to Dr. Stone for the remainder of my pets life. And Jabba is going to live as long as I do 😉

I'm very happy with SJ Animal Hspital.  After adopting a pet cat, I brought my pet to SJ Animal Hospital for an initial check-up, and we returned a year later for his annual check-up and vaccination.  It was very easy to make and appointment.  Both visits went well.  All of the staff was friendly and my pet received the care and attention he needed.  I will definitely use this place for future visits.

I can't recommend San Jose Animal Hospital enough. Dr. Stone is incredible. He always makes me feel heard and ensures my concerns are addressed. I'm truly happy with the care both of my dogs receive here. The staff are all welcoming, kind, and the facility is consistently clean and well-maintained. The pricing is very reasonable, especially with the THRIVE plus option, which has saved me a lot of money.

Just this morning, I noticed a pus-filled growth on my dog's foot. I called and they got me in for an appointment an hour later. They quickly addressed my concerns and got my pup feeling better in no time. Those pesky foxtails! I have so many positive things to say about this vet. If you're considering it, do not hesitate—it's worth it!

Cannot recommend these folks enough. They will get you in fast, they won't waste your time, and the prices are better than anywhere else around. The technician Meera was uniquely attentive, kind, understanding, and made sure to get a holistic view of the issue we were having with our domestic shorthair. No treatments or medications were forcefully pushed on us or shamed on us and we were given multiple treatment options. We will return here for future vet visits!

I cannot say enough about the kind and compassionate care that my dogs receive here. We have been going here for at least 15 years and yesterday had to put our dog down. From puppyhood to old age he received amazing care from both doctors. It was very hard for us but the staff allowed us all the time we needed. All of the ladies in their office are also very kind and compassionate and helpful. We are so grateful to have this high-quality veterinary care right in our neighborhood.

I am very grateful to this clinic for the excellent care they provided for my cat. She was diagnosed with pyometra and urgently needed to be spayed, which was a very stressful situation for both of us. The entire staff was supportive, attentive, and reassuring throughout the process. They explained everything clearly and made sure my cat received the best care possible. I especially want to recognize the vet tech, Kirra, whose kindness and professionalism stood out. She was patient, compassionate, and truly helped ease a very difficult time. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone seeking dedicated and caring veterinary care.

Wonderful staff, the doctor was great. I highly recommend them! I took my senior dog, and Sasha had a pleasant experience. She wasn’t shaking like she normally would. She was very calm. They don’t over charge for everything. And they didn’t try to make me do anything else other than what I came for. I appreciate that.

It’s incredibly disappointing to have to write this review.  After almost 17 years of being a loyal customer, in my hour of need I was told they were too busy and couldn’t fit us in.  It was an emergency!  my senior pet was having a seizure and they had no room for us?  or for that matter didn’t give us any alternatives for emergency care?  I had to find my own and in the interim my pet suffered another seizure. The receptionists words were “so sorry but it’s near closing time and we don’t have any openings.”. it’s an emergency for crying out loud!
Unforgivable!!!!  My pet passed away because of the wasted time.

For an emergency vet they are absolutely wonderful. Very caring and they keep you up to date on your pets progress. Unfortunately or pet didn’t make it after surgery. The staff is caring and understanding of your grief and works with you to say goodbye to your pet.
The only change I would ask is that they would offer a ceramic paw print and a nose print for your deceased pet. Digital paw prints are just not enough. 💔 I really can’t say enough about the staff, from the front receptionist all the way to the surgeon to the vet techs, everyone is fantastic.
Thank you Sage for making our family member as comfortable as you could!
RIP Bristol @wg_bristol My little muppet
#komondor

Our doggo, Chewy, has been treated at Sage Campbell for a potential heart issue - chronic cough about a year and a half ago as well as a TPLO knee surgery in September and a second TPLO about a week ago.
We found Sage via referral by our vet. We are so grateful. General vets are great- and- they often don’t know what they are dealing with for serious injuries and illnesses. Sage has a variety of in house specialists that can assess and quickly find the exact issue and the right course of treatment.
Case in point- our 100# plus dog was lame in his rear end- wouldn’t walk. Vet thought spine after doing X-rays and referred to Sage- thank goodness- who after thorough neurology exam, determined not spinal or neurological- and referred to in house orthopedic. Turns out severed acls on both knees - and upon surgery- torn miniscus. Saved us a lot of money, multiple visits.
Now Chewy is on the road to full healing. With this second knee he is so much perkier than with the first surgery- likely due to his other knee is no longer in pain. We are so happy with only a week out.
Also the staff is professional, caring, explain everything. And- they love our dog, treat him with care and treat us with kindness and respect. We are able to call back in and ask questions or email for assistance.
Thank you Dr. Sheue, Shianne and the surgery staff! I am sorry that I likely misspelled your names.

I visited SAGE in Campbell to diagnose my cat's liver problem.  The (non-invasive) ultrasound was something my two local vets could not do.  The doctor gave an informative discussion about the results, which narrowed it down to a few drugs, and surgical option, that I could try.  It is worth while to see what modern medicine can contribute.

My 13.5-year-old dog, Tiki, was recently diagnosed with a heart condition and ascites. We scheduled a cardiology and internal medicine consultation at SAGE. On November 4th, Tiki was examined by cardiologist Dr. Jason Arndt, who took the time to explain in detail exactly what was going on with Tiki’s heart. He determined that Tiki’s symptoms were all caused by his cardiac issue and that an internal medicine visit was unnecessary — and he was absolutely right.

Dr. Arndt prescribed a treatment plan for Tiki, and nurse Jennifer carefully explained how to administer each medication. What impressed me so much was that out of the four medications, we only needed to pay for one — the other three were provided at no cost. They truly think from the patient’s best interest.

Before getting sick, Tiki loved jumping onto the bed. But one day he failed to jump up and fell, and after that he stopped trying. I thought maybe he would never be able to jump again in his life…
But after this visit and starting the medication, just a few days later, he jumped up onto the bed again! His abdomen, which used to look distended and feel firm, is now noticeably softer and less swollen. His energy is clearly better too.

Dr. Arndt is not only highly professional, but also exceptionally honest and caring. He proactively suggested canceling the internal medicine appointment to save us unnecessary expenses — and his judgment has proven completely correct. Tiki’s improvement in such a short time has given us so much relief and hope.

I am deeply grateful to Dr. Arndt and nurse Jennifer, as well as everyone at SAGE who has helped Tiki. Their medical skills and integrity are truly trustworthy. Thank you so much for taking such wonderful care of him!

My experience with SAGE has been outstanding. My dog underwent a major surgery recently and they treated her with such wonderful care. We went from getting bad news on scans on a Tuesday, to having surgery the following week. All of the team members I’ve met so far have been kind and compassionate professionals, and very accommodating to us traveling from 6 hours away. I chose SAGE over UC Davis due to prompt response and scheduling, I made the right choice!

A truly outstanding vet! I brought my first dog as a new puppy over 10 years ago, and they took good care of him until he passed from cancer. When I adopted a new puppy this month, even though I've moved a bit further away, I decided to continue with Tama Vet because they've always been very professional and caring. I find their prices to be reasonable and fair.

For more than 10 years, our dog, Coco, was under the care of Tama Veterinary, and I cannot express enough how grateful we are for their unwavering support. No matter the issue, no matter the time of day, they were always there—with patience, compassion, and genuine love for our furry family member.

I would recommend this vet too anyone that is in need of a timely professional procedure !!

THANK YOU 🙏 FROM KIKI!

Dr Hoehn and all the staff at Tama Vet hospital have been vital in saving my dog, Lily’s life more times than we can count. I would recommend Tama vet to anyone who is looking for the highest quality care for their furry family members.

The best and most caring doctors and receptionists. Tama vet saved my dog’s life twice - even finding care for him when he had a medical emergency while we were traveling out of state. Thank you to everyone at Tama Vet! 🐾

Great Staff and service! They do well to make you feel included most of the time and understand where we are coming from for the most part. An easy, thorough, and fast experience!

Not recommended be aware.

On Thanksgiving evening my family took our mini poodle to ARCHVET because she had a seizure. Luz, the receptionist was very kind & compassionate. She was very professional, examined our fur baby and made her assessment which in most part we took because we wanted her home with us. The staff showed professionalism,  compassion,  understanding and support to my family.

The vet tech and receptionist were very sweet. However, we did not have a great experience with the vet. We brought our dog in April because at the time we thought she had injured her left paw. The vet was wanting to take a whole bunch of x-rays but I didn’t think it was necessary so they gave us a muscle relaxer and we went home. Once we got home I discovered her left leg started to go out and left eye began to droop. We immediately went back feeling so guilty we didn’t get the x-rays and they took a series but said there was no significant findings. I am no stranger to a stroke since I work in the medical field so I kept asking the vet if she thought it could be that. The vet kept insisting it was not a stroke and just a soft tissue injury and that she would be up and walking in a few days. The vet kept saying a lot without saying anything if that makes sense. But she insisted whatever it was it was not a stroke. Our dog did have a slight fever so they wanted to keep her until midnight to control that for $8,000. We said no because I know she is anxious at the vet to begin with and she wouldn’t be comfortable there, plus by the time we finished checking out the fever had already dropped. But mind you our dog has lost complete function of her left side by now. I knew indeed it was a stroke so we scheduled an appointment with Sage and immediately their vet said it was most likely a stroke or IVDD. After an MRI it confirmed that she suffered a spinal stroke. My problem is that Arch Vet said it was not a stroke and sure maybe they wouldn’t diagnose without an MRI. But they didn’t even suggest that, so encourage us to explore that avenue with a specialist. She was so adamant that it was soft tissue and she would be up and walking in days. It was such a frustrating experience and waste of time and money. Very disappointed

It's nice having a kind, caring veterinarian in the neighborhood. The facilities are beautiful, and the location is convenient at the northeast corner of Pruneridge and Winchester. Our daughter was watching Daisy when she got sick.  She was able to get an appt the same day and our daughter said the staff was very thorough and spent time with her explaining diagnosis and treatment.  Staff was very nice and facility was very clean.  Thank you for taking great care of Daisy.

Everyone was super accommodating and they saw our cat as soon as possible. The receptionist, technician, and the vet were all very helpful and answered all our questions. I would definitely trust them to take care of my cat again in the future!

Oakridge vet staff have been a huge help with our new kitten. They are very quick to respond to my texts and the staff are very knowledgeable. The doctors are amazing and very knowledgeablel especially Dr. Munos.. They treat your furry, baby.

The entire staff at West Valley Pet Clinic is amazing! Over the years, I have received timely, kind, and efficient care for my dear Bella. There were a couple of times when Bella was really sick and they worked her into the schedule. The team does a great job of follow-up to ensure she is doing well.

I wish there were zero star.  If you are looking for a compassionate care, especially sick pets, run far away from this clinic.  Both the Vet and the staff are at fault because the messages were either not relayed to the doctor or the doctor totally ignore them or don't care, or don't have a good system of follow up and patient communication.  I don't know how this clinic got a 4.8 overall star, probably before Dr. Eric got on board because he was the worst VET I have ever met, not to mention he was also my personal friend.  My cat Coco fell through the crack under his care and DIED because he failed to diagnose her condition sooner and asked us to take her to the hospital right away when her body weight was already 50% of her original weight.  His answer was he took the blood test and was waiting to find the result?? I gave him the story of all the signs of kidney failure even 4 months ago.  He couldn't assess it clinically, and always had to rely on lab result?? His documentation were all incorrect also;  her weight initially was 11 lbs, and he recorded as 9 lbs, so when she lost her weight to 7 lbs, he said only 2 lbs, so no concern?? Even though I told him she had been peeing outside the litter box, and not eating much.   I am not a VET, so how am I supposed to know these could be the signs of kidney failure, and if you put that together with weight loss, he was not concerned?  or gave me any warning signs to look out for?? I messaged the clinic about my concern in May 2025, and apparently someone did see my message and replied to me and said that he/she will forward that message to Dr. Eric.  I never received any phone calls, texts, or emails back.  Not mentioning any concerns over the symptoms I reported to him, I thought maybe it was ok.  Now 4 months later, I brought her back to him because she lost another 3 lbs, and yet he did not show any concerns whatsoever, and never mentioned she may have "kidney disease". Given that she lost 50% of her weight, from 11 lbs to 6 lbs, he sent her home, and just wait for the lab result which he said he will call me the next day, but he did not call me until 2 days later with an alarming high creatinine,  an imminent kidney failure!! We rushed her to SAGE Vet hospital, where the Vet there already was recommending me to take her down the very first day.  We waited a few more days, and went back for follow up visits at SAGE, and were told repeatedly to put her down.  We finally did, during  all confusion and sadness which I regretted and went through a very painful and traumatic experience of putting her down.  Dr. Eric did not even call me until 4 days after she died and acted as if he did not know anything about the message I sent 4 months ago about my concerns.  He said emails get mixed up and buried??? Don't they have a reliable system of communicating with the patients?  He said he will investigate about that and let me know, but I never received any calls or emails back now it's a week already.   What?  your emails got buried?? I even asked the staff again before all this happened the second time, and no response from the staff either.  The nurse was even "joking" about how skinny Coco was that she could just slip the collar right off.  Was that funny?? How insensitive and uncaring, and lack of empathy!
I am now going through PTSD, post-traumatic stress disorder, waking up in the middle of night with anxiety, depression, and going through therapy with a psychiatrist.  I cannot forget the eyes of Coco begging to live.  This is the most painful experience I have ever had in my life.
Stay away from this clinic if you want your pet to live.
No pet parent or pet should have to live through this, EVER.
I am now left with over $10k of vet bill and a DEAD CAT, and a broken heart that will never heal.

Maureen

Gurvinder Bath does not care about the well-being of your pet, and this has become extremely clear through my family's experience with him.

At the end of 2023, we found out my dog had a cancerous growth on her back. On January 10th, 2024, the growth was removed. The doctor explained at the time that fatty tissue was placed where the tumor had been to protect her spine. Since then, my dog has had a bump in that same spot. We were always told this was normal and simply the fatty tissue that they had put there.

When we took her in during summer 2024, we were told again that it was fine — just inflammation — nothing more. Fast forward to now, September 2025, and suddenly we are being told for the first time that the fatty tissue was supposed to dissipate, and that it’s “not surprising” her cancer has come back because this type of cancer is “very common.” This was never communicated to us before. We were only ever told to “monitor for new growths,” but never that this type of cancer often reoccurs or that we should be particularly concerned about the same spot.

To make matters worse, at her most recent checkup, the doctor was nearly finished with the examination without even touching or checking the very obvious bump on her back (the site of the previous cancer). It was only because my dad specifically pointed it out that the doctor finally looked at it. Considering we were taking her in for a full body checkup, the fact that part of her body wasn’t even examined until we specifically pointed it out is extremely concerning.

When I expressed my frustration over this new information, the doctor’s response was literally: “Well, it’s cancer, cancer comes back.” That kind of dismissive attitude is incredibly hurtful, especially when I was simply trying to advocate for our dog’s health.

This situation feels like information was withheld. If we had been told the cancer was likely to return, we would have been more proactive and vigilant. Instead, we were reassured over and over again that the bump was “just fatty tissue.” Now I’m left wondering if my other dog, who recently passed away from cancer under this clinic’s care, also suffered because of miscommunication or lack of transparency.

I am extremely disappointed. As pet owners, we place our dogs’ health and well-being in the hands of veterinarians, trusting them to give us the complete picture immediately—not to make us wait over a year for important information. Clear communication and thorough examinations could have made a tremendous difference for us and for our dogs.

My cat Mittens has been sneezing all her life and is now bleeding from her nose. We have gone back and fourth trying to find the solution and the best you guys can do is give her FLUIDS. That’s not a solution you keep charging us for vet visits with end in sight.

I hope my cat doesn’t die because of your negligence

Gurvinder Bath is using people for their money and not actually providing thorough care for their pets.

Yesterday I brought my dog in for a checkup that lasted less than five minutes. He barely looked at her and tried to send her out without even examining the very obvious bump on her back or checking her body properly. The only reason the appointment went longer is because I pointed out two things he had completely ignored. When I called out how poor the exam was, he brushed me off and said it was a “normal routine checkup.” That is not a checkup — it’s taking people’s money without doing the work.

Today, I went back to request a refund and to get both of my dogs’ full medical records. Instead of being professional, the staff gave me a hard time. One front desk worker with a lip piercing laughed throughout the entire situation, which was incredibly disrespectful.

At first, they only gave me a summary, even though I had clearly asked for the full records. After I pushed, they finally gave them to me — but it was obvious the files had been altered. Everything was printed, but there were pen markings on the pages. They stalled, wasted two hours of my time, and when I asked for Gurvinder Bath’s veterinary license number, he himself refused to provide it.

Regarding the refund, they initially said they would provide it, but then told me there was no way to process it because their system wouldn’t allow it. They offered no alternative solution and seemed to expect me to just accept that. After at least an hour of going back and forth with them, they finally gave me the refund in cash.

To make matters worse, his business card is not displayed anywhere in the office. I asked countless times for one and was either ignored or flat-out refused each time. What’s even more concerning is that there was another veterinarian’s card on display — but not his.

This entire experience makes it clear that Gurvinder Bath and his staff care more about money than about honesty, professionalism, or the well-being of the animals they are supposed to treat. If you love your pet, do not take them here.
